title: 第2章 银剑峰
content_zh:
第2章银剑峰
蜀山，银剑峰。
楚梁睁开了眼，目光明亮。
看了看外面的时辰，还很早。火红的太阳刚出山，朝霞染红了半边天。
到这个世界半年多，自己已经完全习惯了早起啊。
没错，他原本不是这个世界的人，而是一名刚刚结束高考的毕业生。前一天才知道自己考了全省第三的好成绩，第二天刚出门就被一名酒驾的司机撞上了天。
再醒来时，就发现自己来到了这个光怪离奇的世界。
之所以说离奇，是因为这里有妖魔作祟、龙蛇起陆，鬼神之力通天，凡人命如草芥。多亏有九天十地为首的诸多仙门镇压，才能守住人间太平。
人类的修行者同样强大，武者能凭肉身开山裂石，书生意气可敌千军万马，道门天师能呼风唤雨，佛门高僧曾一指降龙……
楚梁的前身，就是一名全家被妖魔害死的孤儿。只有他自己被师父所救，因为有修行资质，便被带回了山上。
所以前身特别痛恨邪祟，极度想要尽快修成神通，好下山斩妖除魔。可正因为太过急切，道心不稳，反倒在一次突破时走火入魔，神魂消散。
也只能感慨一声，真是人生无常。
楚梁的灵魂降临这个世界之后，心里的第一感觉其实是恐慌。身为一个在和平年代长大的少年，这种妖魔横行的世道令他相当不安。
尤其是他承载的记忆中，还有前身的父母亲人被妖魔害死的惨烈画面，对心灵的冲击是相当之大。
但是，他很快就想清楚。恐惧，来源于火力不足。
弱小的人必然整日活在恐惧中，想要彻底摆脱这种不安，唯一的办法就是变强。而自己拥有修行资质，还降临在蜀山派这样一座顶流仙门之内，已然是相当不错的开局。
更妙的是，在穿越之后，他还发现自己的神魂中有了一点变化。
就是那座塔的出现。
每当他观想时，脑海中就会出现一座白色巨塔，在斩妖之后还会给予宝物作为奖励。这在前身的记忆中并不存在，像是伴随自己来的，或许就是传说中的金手指？
起初的楚梁不敢去找大妖，就在蜀山周边村镇寻一些乱葬岗、坟地之类的地方，斩杀一些灯笼怪。

灯笼怪这种邪祟就是死者怨念依附在灯笼上，化为鬼火，会在夜里飘荡冲撞活人。撞上一下，灯笼怪自身立马烟消云散，被撞的人则至多病上一场。相对于修者，可以说是毫无战力。
弱小到了令人喜爱的程度。
炼化一只灯笼怪的奖励是一颗辅助修行的聚气丹，虽然本身并不多珍稀，但数量够多，还是让他的修炼速度大为提升。
有一次偶然遇到一只体型笨重、防御坚固的石像精行凶，经过漫长的鏖战之后，楚梁成功将其磨死。
白塔才第一次给出法宝的奖励，就是那块令蜘蛛精现形的金砖。
【照妖宝砖】：用此砖照人头部拍下，若此人是妖物幻化，则会立刻现出原形；若非妖物幻化，则会感到疼痛，有一定程度触发眩晕效果，真假立辨。
对于此宝，楚梁的评价是相当实用。
丹药、法宝、神通功法……这些在修仙界都是极为珍贵的东西，即使是蜀山弟子，也要替宗门完成任务才能去换取资源和宝物。
而楚梁只要斩妖就能获取，并且随着斩杀妖物的实力增强，获得的宝物品级也会提升，对自身战力的增强自然也会更大。
所以楚梁现在就处于一个“因为怕妖怪，所以杀妖怪”的逻辑闭环中，从某种角度上讲，反而实现了前身的一部分愿望。
慢悠悠地穿衣束发、打水洗漱，之后算是正式的起了床。
推开门，走出小木屋，眼望处天高云淡，正是暮春四月的时节，风中带着草木香。沿着鸟语花香的路，绕过半边山坡，来到了峰顶的一座阁楼前。
他是来找师父的。
阁楼的大门敞开着，一走进门，就见前方神台前躺着一个大咧咧的曼妙身影。
这是一个长发披散的女子，半边脸颊被发丝遮着，露出的半张脸玉嫩光泽，面部轮廓如水墨勾勒，泛着红，颈部线条精致如美瓷。
着一身对襟玄色袍子，即使躺着也能看出胸前极为饱满，如同满月，随着均匀的呼吸而波澜起伏，一块含着红芒的玉牌陷在其中，引人注目。腰肢处一紧，束着一条缎带，胯部渐宽，两条长长的大腿甩在外面，白腻肉感。
她的手边还垂着一个偌大的酒葫芦，走进门来，还能听见浅浅的鼾声，可谓是毫无仪态。
虽然睡得熟，但随着楚梁脚步声一响，女子还是有所警觉，一下睁开眼来。
“师尊。”楚梁在门口轻轻唤了一声。
不错，这女子正是楚梁的师父，蜀山三十六峰之一的银剑峰峰主，帝女凤。

“呀，天都亮啦。”帝女凤一翻身，坐起来，衣衫凌乱，肩胛半露，场面犹如犯罪现场。
她也不整理衣服，而是先挠了挠头发，眼波朦胧看向楚梁，“你来干嘛？”
尚且是有点懵。
“嗯……”楚梁抬眼道：“是师尊纸鹤传书，叫我回来之后就来找您的啊。”
“有这事儿吗？”宿醉的女人挠挠脑袋，突然噢了一声，“我想起来了！”
她这才拉扯了两下衣服，站起身来。原本躺着还不算夸张，一站起来，更显出身姿高挑且曲线惊人。
“昨天掌教不是召集峰主议事吗，就说要开始筹备十年一度的蜀山峰会了，你知道吧？就是诸峰弟子参与选首席弟子的那个。”
“弟子知道。”
“结果我又和王玄龄那老家伙吵起来了，我看不惯他那副嚣张样子，在那扬言说什么首席必是他玉剑峰囊中之物……我呸！”帝女凤提起来，仍旧气得胸口跳了两跳，“我当然和他呛声，争吵了几句，就打了个赌。”
“要是玉剑峰的弟子夺得了首席，我就把凰灵血玉给他。要是我银剑峰的弟子能夺得首席之位，他就把诸峰首座的位子让出来给我。”
说着，帝女凤瞥向楚梁，“我找你来是想问问，你说，咱们银剑峰选谁参与蜀山峰会比较好？”
“……”楚梁小无语了一阵，才小声说道：“师尊，咱们银剑峰，不是只有我一个弟子吗……”
“好！”帝女凤一拍手，“你能主动请缨，为师很欣慰啊！”

Chapter 2 Silver Sword Peak
Shushan, Silver Sword Peak.
Chu Liang opened his eyes, his eyes bright.
I looked at the time outside and saw that it was still very early. The fiery red sun had just risen from the mountain, and the morning glow dyed half of the sky red.
After more than half a year in this world, I have become completely accustomed to getting up early.
That's right, he was not originally from this world, but a graduate who had just finished the college entrance examination. I just found out the day before that I had the third best score in the province, and the next day I was hit by a drunk driver as soon as I left the house.
When I woke up again, I found myself in this strange and bizarre world.
The reason why I say bizarre is that there are monsters here, dragons and snakes rise from the land, the power of ghosts and gods reaches the sky, and the lives of mortals are like grass. Thanks to the suppression of many immortal sects led by Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, peace in the world can be maintained.
Human practitioners are equally powerful. Warriors can break mountains and crack rocks with their physical bodies. Scholars can defeat thousands of armies with their energy. Taoist masters can call for wind and rain. Buddhist monks once subdued dragons with one finger...
Chu Liang's predecessor was an orphan whose whole family was killed by demons. Only he himself was saved by the master, and because he had the qualifications to practice, he was taken back to the mountain.
Therefore, the predecessor hated evil spirits very much, and desperately wanted to cultivate supernatural powers as soon as possible so that he could go down the mountain and kill demons. But just because he was too eager and his Taoist mind was unstable, he went crazy during a breakthrough and his soul disappeared.
I can only sigh with emotion, life is really unpredictable.
After Chu Liang's soul came to this world, the first feeling in his heart was actually panic. As a young man who grew up in a peaceful era, this world where demons were rampant made him quite uneasy.
Especially in the memory he carried, there were also tragic scenes of his parents and relatives being killed by demons, which had a huge impact on his soul.
However, he quickly figured it out. Fear comes from insufficient firepower.
Weak people must live in fear all day long. The only way to completely get rid of this anxiety is to become stronger. And he has the qualifications to practice, and he has landed in a top-notch immortal sect like Shushan Sect, which is already a pretty good start.
What's even better is that after traveling through time, he also discovered that there was a slight change in his soul.
It was the appearance of that tower.
Whenever he visualizes, a giant white tower will appear in his mind, and after slaying the demon, he will be given treasures as a reward. This does not exist in the memory of the predecessor. It seems that it comes with him, maybe it is the legendary golden finger?
At first, Chu Liang did not dare to go looking for the big monster, so he looked for some mass graves, cemeteries and other places in the villages and towns around Shushan to kill some lantern monsters.
The evil spirit of the lantern monster is the resentment of the deceased attached to the lantern, turning into a will-o'-the-wisp, which floats around at night and collides with the living. If hit, the lantern monster itself will disappear immediately, and the person hit will at most become ill. Compared to cultivators, it can be said to have no fighting power.
Weak to the point of being endearing.
The reward for refining a lantern monster is a Qi Gathering Pill to assist in training. Although it is not rare in itself, the quantity is enough to greatly increase his training speed.
Once, by chance, he encountered a stone statue that was bulky and well-defended. After a long and fierce battle, Chu Liang succeeded in grinding it to death.
The White Tower gave out the magic weapon reward for the first time, which was the gold brick that made the spider spirit appear.
[Monster Photo Brick]: Use this brick to shine on a person's head and take a picture. If the person is a monster, the original shape will appear immediately; if the person is not a monster, you will feel pain and trigger a dizziness effect to a certain extent. You can distinguish the real from the fake.
Regarding this treasure, Chu Liang's evaluation is that it is quite practical.
Pills, magic weapons, magical powers... these are extremely precious things in the world of immortality. Even Shushan disciples have to complete tasks for the sect in exchange for resources and treasures.
Chu Liang can obtain it by slaying monsters, and as the strength of slaying monsters increases, the level of the treasures obtained will also increase, which will naturally increase his own combat power.
So Chu LiangNow we are in a logical closed loop of "killing monsters because I am afraid of monsters". From a certain perspective, it has fulfilled part of the wishes of my predecessor.
I slowly dressed and tied my hair, fetched water and washed myself, and then officially got up.
Opening the door and walking out of the cabin, I looked at the clear sky and clear clouds. It was late spring in April, and the wind carried the fragrance of grass and trees. Following the path filled with birdsong and flowers, around half of the hillside, we arrived at a loft at the top of the mountain.
He came to see the master.
The door to the attic was open. As soon as he walked in, he saw a carefree and graceful figure lying in front of the altar.
This is a woman with long and disheveled hair, half of her cheeks are covered by hair, and the exposed half of her face is tender and shiny. The outline of her face is like an ink outline, glowing red, and the lines of her neck are as delicate as beautiful porcelain.
Wearing a double-breasted black robe, even when lying down, you can see that her chest is extremely full, like a full moon, rising and falling with even breathing, and a jade plaque with red light is trapped in it, which is eye-catching. The waist was tightened and tied with a ribbon, the crotch gradually widened, and the two long thighs were exposed, white and fleshy.
There was a huge wine gourd hanging by her hand. When she walked in, she could still hear light snores, which could be described as having no manners.
Although she was sleeping soundly, the woman was still alert and opened her eyes when Chu Liang's footsteps sounded.
"Master." Chu Liang called softly at the door.
Yes, this woman is Chu Liang's master, the master of Yinjian Peak, one of the thirty-six peaks of Shu Mountain, the Emperor's Daughter Feng.
"Ah, it's already dawn." Emperor Feng turned over and sat up. Her clothes were messy and her shoulder blades were half exposed. The scene was like a crime scene.
She didn't straighten her clothes, but scratched her hair first and looked at Chu Liang with hazy eyes, "What are you doing here?"
Still a little confused.
"Well..." Chu Liang raised his eyes and said, "It was Master Zhihe who sent a message, asking me to come find you when I come back."
"Is this happening?" The hungover woman scratched her head and suddenly said, "I remembered it!"
Then she pulled her clothes twice and stood up. It wasn't too exaggerated when she was lying down at first, but when she stood up, she even showed her tall figure and amazing curves.
"Didn't the Headmaster convene the peak masters yesterday to discuss matters? He said that he would start preparations for the Shushan Summit held every ten years. You know, right? It's the one where the disciples from all the peaks participate in the selection of the chief disciple."
"Disciple knows."
"As a result, I got into an argument with that old guy Wang Xuanling again. I couldn't stand his arrogance, and he threatened that the chief executive must be in his pocket at Jade Sword Peak... Bah!" Emperor Daughter Feng mentioned it, still so angry that her chest jumped twice. "Of course I choked with him, argued with him for a few words, and then made a bet."
"If the disciple of Jade Sword Peak wins the top position, I will give him the Phoenix Spirit Blood Jade. If my disciple of Silver Sword Peak wins the top position, he will give up his seat at the top of the peaks to me."
As she said that, Emperor Daughter Feng glanced at Chu Liang, "I came to you to ask, who do you think it would be better for us at Yinjian Peak to choose to participate in Shu Peak?"
"..." Chu Liang was speechless for a while, then whispered: "Master, am I not the only disciple in our Silver Sword Peak..."
"Okay!" Emperor Daughter Feng clapped her hands, "I'm very pleased that you can take the initiative to ask me to be my teacher!"
